name: @funcd-dev/shim
description: funcd Node runtime shim — TypeScript + Hono over node:http, bundled to shim.mjs (ADR-0037, supersedes ADR-0030's hand-written shim)

scripts.build:shim: esbuild src/shim.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=shim.mjs --banner:js="// GENERATED from shim/src/shim.ts by 'yarn build' (esbuild). Do not edit by hand."
scripts.build:pool: esbuild src/pool.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=pool.mjs --banner:js="// GENERATED from shim/src/pool.ts by 'yarn build' (esbuild). Do not edit by hand."
